data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. We understand this is causing difficulty for your team. The 'Domain not allowed' error, often seen as SSO-GOOGLE-403, typically means that specific domains haven't been added to your permitted list. Please have an administrator log into the CloudDesk Admin Console and navigate to the 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO. From there, check the 'Allowed Domains' list and ensure that all the domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO are included. [T-2607] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
